ChartCard.description: The card every chart sits in: bg/card, a border-default edge, radius-2xl, 16px in and 16 between rows. Row one: the title (16/24 medium, text/default) and, when there are `periods`, a small Select for the period at the right. Row two: the KPI (text/xl semibold) with its change badge, and the range under it in text/muted, 2px apart; without a KPI the range sits 4px under the title. Then the chart. The card is a size container, so a chart can lay itself out wider from 560px (`@min-[560px]:`).

ChartLegendPill.description: chart/legendPill. - `outline`: an outline pill with no fill — 8px swatch, label, value 6 apart, 6 / 10 in. Active turns the ring border-strong. - `plain` (the Donut legend): no ring and no value, 6 / 8 in; active fills bg/hover, as plain controls do on hover. Dimmed fades the content to 45%, never the ground.

ChartTooltip.description: The chart tooltip pill with its pointer. Exported for custom charts. With `anchor` it floats over the page (see Floating): it never gets cut off by the card, flips below when there's no room above, slides in from the screen edge, and its pointer keeps pointing at the anchor. Without it, it renders in place. A chart whose tooltip follows the pointer from point to point moves it with `useGlide`.

props.name: anchor
props.description: What it points at: an element, or a stand-in (`glideAnchor`).

props.name: updateRef
props.description: Gets a function that moves it to the anchor within the frame, for an anchor that glides (see Floating).

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the anchor and the pointer's tip.

ChartLegendRow.description: One legend row: 8px swatch, label, value and an optional note.
